title: A low privilege account reaches an admin function (needs two accounts)
summary: A normal user can reach a function meant for administrators.  Proving it needs a low privilege session and an admin session.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.

reproduce: Request the admin route with a low privilege session and check it is allowed.
remediate: Enforce role checks on every privileged function on the server.
